For example, in the Islamic practice of naming babies, Nuaimah may be given to a newborn girl as a reminder of the beautiful and fragile nature of life.

The name reminds us of the transient nature of life and the importance of cherishing every moment. It also reflects the concept of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards His creation. The word 'Nu'aimah' is derived from the root words 'Nu'um' (grace) and 'Aimah' (delicate, tender), emphasizing the gentle and merciful nature of Allah. In the Quran, we are reminded to be grateful for Allah's blessings and to make the most of our time on earth.
